recipe.visualDefinition: A central vertical hourglass contained within a light-blue rectangular inset, set against a vast, heavily textured background resembling aged stone or mottled parchment. The composition is strictly symmetrical and centered.
coreVisualRelationships: The clean, cool blue inset contrasts sharply with the warm, chaotic texture of the background.
The verticality of the hourglass aligns with the vertical axis of the centered typography.
The metallic gold of the top text echoes the warm highlights in the stone texture.
coreInvariants: Centered rectangular inset with a thin border
Mottled, organic background texture with earth tones

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The hourglass is the primary subject, centered and occupying approximately 30% of the vertical height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The rectangular blue frame serves as the primary visual anchor against the busy background.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the top display text, moves down to the hourglass, and settles on the smaller metadata text at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive negative space provided by the textured background creates a sense of isolation and importance for the central icon.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm earth tones (ochre, sienna, tan) dominate the background texture.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pale sky blue provides a cool, clean contrast within the central frame.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Metallic gold or yellow is used for the primary display typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation in the background with a high-value, medium-saturation blue in the center to draw focus.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to earth tones and sky blues

letterConstructionRules: Wide, square proportions for the display text
Sharp, clean edges with a metallic beveled effect
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'S' has a flattened, wide curve
The 'X' is perfectly symmetrical and wide

composition.relationshipToImage: placed directly above the central frame
placed directly below the central frame

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A wide, bold display face paired with a tiny, tracked-out secondary face for a cinematic feel.
graphicDevices: Thin rectangular border around the central image

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the wide, square geometric feel of the display text.
Matches the technical, wide sans-serif aesthetic.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a background with a heavy, mottled stone or aged parchment texture in shades of ochre and brown. In the center, place a vertical rectangular frame with a thin border containing a clean, pale blue gradient and a detailed, symmetrical hourglass with sand falling.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add wide, bold, gold-beveled geometric sans-serif text at the top center. Add small, highly-tracked white sans-serif text at the bottom center, aligned with the width of the central frame.

verificationChecks: Is the background texture sufficiently organic and non-repetitive?
Does the blue inset have a clean, distinct border?
Is the top text wide and metallic?

adjustableVariables: Color of the sand in the hourglass
Width of the tracking on the bottom text
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the gold text looks beveled and not flat yellow.
Check that the hourglass is vertically oriented.
Verify the background doesn't look like a repeating pattern.
Confirm the blue inset is a perfect rectangle.
Check that the text is perfectly centered horizontally.
recipe.reuseFormula: Stone texture background + Centered blue frame + Hourglass icon + Wide-tracked geometric sans-serif typography.
